# PLAN — iteration 1
## Current state assessment
The baseline is timing-feasible on `xc7a35tcpg236-1` at 10 ns (routed WNS 0.317 ns, WHS 0.041 ns) and uses 25 LUTs and 37 FFs. The objective is strictly fewer LUTs while preserving the known top latency annotation `// @latency 33` and all defined behavior. No prior proposal outcomes are supplied.

## Hypothesis
Use `rsp_data_reg` as the receive shift register during transfers, removing the separate `rx_shift` register and its final copy into the response register; this may reduce LUT use while keeping the valid response and its timing unchanged.

## Instruction for generator
In `spi_master_core`, remove `rx_shift` and shift sampled `miso` bits directly into `rsp_data_reg` on the existing odd-toggle sample edges; at completion, assert `rsp_valid_reg` without copying a separate receive register. Keep `rsp_data_reg` reset behavior and ensure its value is stable from response assertion through retirement; its intermediate value while `rsp_valid` is low is unspecified by the contract. Preserve the existing toggle schedule, `HALF_PERIOD` behavior, handshakes, reset priority, output registration, top interface, and top `// @latency 33` annotation. Expect fewer LUTs from removing the receive-to-response copy logic; retain the candidate only if all deterministic gates pass and routed LUT use is strictly below the incumbent.
